external_collaboration.evidence_quote: [agronomy company logo]Actura is a leading player in the agricultural supplies trade. Since 2026, Bloomeo has been used by the Etamines network, which aims to identify solutions for farmers and winegrowers by conducting more than 500 agronomic trials each year. Bloomeo is used to manage all trials, including complex trials involving biologicals, crop varieties, and conventional crop protection & nutrition products.

[agronomy company logo]Ad Terram, is a renowned bio-stimulant and seed treatment company based in the Netherlands. Ad Terram develops and produces innovative organic microplastic-free seed treatment solutions for sustainable agriculture, focusing on improving soil health, nutrient efficiency, and crop resilience. AdTerram will use Bloomeo primarily to manage their internal R&D trials
[agronomy company logo]Agri-Obtentions, historical French seed company in cooperation with INRAE.

[agronomy company logo]Agrow Seeds is an international vegetable seed company with product development activities across multiple regions. Its teams conduct field trials to evaluate new varieties under diverse conditions. Bloomeo Product Development supports mobile data collection and centralized trial analysis.

[agronomy company logo]Part of the Japanese Ajinomoto Group, Ajinomoto is a key player in amino science and food innovation. The company develops and evaluates biosolutions across multiple crops and geographies. Bloomeo Biosolutions helps structure trial data and better contextualize product performance across environments.

[agronomy company logo]Axioma Biologicals develops innovative biostimulants and microbial technologies for sustainable agriculture. The company conducts extensive laboratory and field trials to validate product efficacy. Bloomeo Biosolutions is used to streamline trials, optimize data management, and accelerate product development.

[agronomy company logo]BCF Life Sciences is a French biotech company developing natural biostimulants derived from amino acids extracted from poultry feather keratin. The company runs R&D and field trials to validate product performance. Bloomeo Biosolutions is used to manage, analyze, and secure biosolutions trial data.

[agronomy company logo]Berries del Oeste is a berry producer operating across Spain and Morocco. The company evaluates varieties and agronomic practices to improve yield and fruit quality. Bloomeo centralizes trial data and supports product development decisions.

[agronomy company logo]Biomanity is a French startup developing a super-absorbent solution based on chitin derived from insects and crustacean shells. Their product helps plants withstand drought periods by storing large amounts of water in the soil and gradually releasing it when needed. It also provides biostimulant benefits. Biomanity is using Bloomeo Biosolutions to manage their R&D trials.

[agronomy company logo]Bio-T (Biocentury Transgene) is active in cotton, field crops, vegetables, and horticultural seeds. Its teams conduct transgenic and biotechnology research programs. RnDExp™ by Doriane is used to centralize and secure biotech research data.

[agronomy company logo]BISI International is a leading Indonesian seed company and a subsidiary of the CP Group, active in field crops and vegetables. Its breeding teams manage biotechnology and variety development programs across multiple crops. Doriane software supports breeding data management and experimental workflows.

[agronomy company logo]The BIVB (Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne) supports innovation across the Burgundy wine value chain. The organization conducts rootstock and varietal trials to address climate and sustainability challenges. Bloomeo is used to standardize protocols and optimize trial data collection and analysis.

[agronomy company logo]CEP Innovation develops fruit tree varieties and rootstocks in partnership with INRAE, targeting sustainable fruit production worldwide. Its programs include breeding, testing, and long-term variety evaluation. Bloomeo supports the management of breeding and testing data across projects.

[agronomy company logo]Cérience breeds, produces and distributes seeds with a portfolio of more than 200 varieties of fodders, alfalfas, cover crops, pulses and seeds for field crops. Their innovations have a dual purpose: Improving yields while reducing our environmental footprint. Bloomeo Breeding implementation started in 2026.

[agronomy company logo]CN Seeds is a UK-based seed company specializing in leafy vegetables and niche crops. The company runs breeding programs and multi-location trials across Europe to evaluate new varieties. Bloomeo Product Development supports trial coordination and comparative data analysis.

[agronomy company logo]Cosucra develops plant-based food ingredients derived from chicory and peas. Its R&D teams run breeding and testing programs to improve raw material quality. Bloomeo supports breeding data management and cross-team collaboration.

[agronomy company logo]Cristal Union is a major European cooperative active in sugar beet production and processing. The group conducts plant breeding programs, as well as agronomic and varietal trials to improve crop performance. Doriane supports long-term data management for field research programs.

[agronomy company logo]CTIFL is the French interprofessional technical institute for fruit and vegetable production. The institute conducts applied research and multi-site trials to support growers and value chains. Bloomeo is used to manage all their experimentation and secure the related data.

[agronomy company logo]DARkWIN is a European collaborative research project funded by Horizon Europe, focusing on pollinator-assisted selection under heat and drought stress. The project combines plant breeding, phenotyping, and advanced data analysis. Doriane is used to manage breeding data and deliver advanced analytics on complex genotype–environment interactions

[agronomy company logo]The Biotechnology Center of DBN (Da Bei Nong) conducts advanced research in transgenesis and molecular breeding. Its teams manage large volumes of molecular and experimental data. RnDExp™ supports data structuring and traceability across biotech research programs.

[agronomy company logo]Fito Semillas is the first independent Spanish seed company, active in breeding, biotechnology, and product development. The company runs long-term breeding and testing programs across multiple crops. Doriane supports end-to-end data management from research to variety evaluation, on field crops.

[agronomy company logo]GabonaKutato is Hungary’s agricultural research institute conducting variety, agrochemical, and crop production research. Since 2020, the institute has centralized its trials and research workflows using Doriane’s RnDExp™ platform. This has improved data consistency and management across experimental programs.

[agronomy company logo]Gentos is a leader in genetic improvement of forage species in South America. Its breeding programs focus on performance and adaptation across diverse environments. Doriane software centralizes breeding data and supports research activities across locations.

[agronomy company logo]Global Papua Abadi, an Indonesian agri-food company focused on tropical sugarcane production, and implements Bloomeo Agronomy Testing to streamline their multi-factorial testing programs on sugarcane.

[agronomy company logo]Guerra GT is the result of a collaboration between RAGT and Grupo Guerra, with research centers in Paraná and Goiás focusing on corn and wheat seed development. The teams use Doriane software to organize breeding programs and centralize the associated data. This supports genetic improvement and enhanced varietal performance across environments.

[agronomy company logo]Hazera is an international vegetable seed company with breeding and product development activities worldwide. Its teams evaluate varieties across a wide range of crops and growing conditions. Bloomeo supports the management and analysis of multi-location product development trials.

[agronomy company logo]HM.CLAUSE is a global vegetable seed company serving growers in more than 100 countries. The company conducts extensive product development trials to adapt varieties to diverse climates and market needs. Bloomeo Product Development supports global trial coordination and data-driven decision-making.

[agronomy company logo]The IGS project is a Eurostars-funded research initiative led by Doriane. The project explores data-driven approaches to better understand biological product performance at scale. Doriane provides the data management and analytical foundation of the project.

[agronomy company logo]INRAE is one of the world’s leading public research organizations in agriculture, food, and the environment. Research units conduct complex breeding, agronomy, and experimental programs across multiple sites. Doriane supports data management workflows and ensures traceability of research data for some of INRAE’s programs.

[agronomy company logo]IRTA is a Catalan public research institute dedicated to agri-food research and innovation. Its teams conduct breeding, agronomy, and variety testing programs across a wide range of crops. Doriane software is used to manage experimental data and support multi-year research projects.

[agronomy company logo]Jinse Nonghua Seed is a subsidiary of the DBN Group focused on breeding and research in rice, corn, cotton, and canola. Researchers have used RnDExp™ by Doriane since 2016 for breeding data management and agro-research integration. This supports collaboration and standardization across breeding programs.

[agronomy company logo]The Julius Kühn Institute is Germany’s federal research center for cultivated plants. Its research programs involve complex breeding and experimental data workflows. Doriane is used to standardize data management and support collaboration.

[agronomy company logo]Kauffman Seeds develops and evaluates crop varieties across multiple U.S. states. The company runs multi-location trials to support variety selection and market positioning. Bloomeo Product Development structures trial data and supports comparative analysis.

[agronomy company logo]Kelp Blue develops sustainable kelp-based biostimulants for agriculture. The company conducts agronomic trials to validate product performance under field conditions. Bloomeo Biosolutions is used to centralize trial data and support agronomic analysis.

[agronomy company logo]Krajowa Grupa Spożywcza (KGS) is a major Polish agri-food and seed group. Its teams conduct breeding programs, variety testing and evaluation programs across multiple locations. Bloomeo supports collaboration, breeding program management, and data consistency across trial networks.

[agronomy company logo]Limagrain is an international cooperative group specializing in seed development and agricultural innovation. Its research teams manage complex germplasm characterization and seed production programs. Bloomeo is used to structure data workflows and standardize protocols across research and production activities.
Marionnet Label

MAY Seed is a major Turkish seed company active in vegetable, field, industrial, and forage crop breeding and production. Its R&D teams conduct trials on sunflower, corn, cotton, and other crops to develop new varieties and agronomic practices. Doriane software is used to manage breeding workflows and research data.

Mercier is a century-old family company known for vine stocks, viticulture services, and agri-biotechnological innovation. In 2021, the company adopted Doriane software to standardize agronomic analysis data and centralize information for its plant selection activities. This has strengthened real-time traceability and reporting across research and testing.

Morel Diffusion is a world leader in Cyclamen flowers, recognized for breeding both standard F1 hybrids and notable varietal innovations. The company has been digitizing its breeding and variety trial data with Doriane software since 2000 to support its research and creation processes. This centralization enables better traceability and decision-making across breeding cycles.

[agronomy company logo]RAGT is a leading European seed company belonging to a major agricultural cooperative group. The company runs large-scale breeding and product development programs across field crops, including cereals, maize, oilseeds, and forages. Doriane software supports plant breeding operations, variety evaluation and data harmonization across +25 research stations and more than 300 users worldwide.

[agronomy company logo]REMED is a collaborative project aiming to improve the experimentation of biosolutions through a shared research infrastructure. The project covers trial methodologies, experimental networks, and data governance. Doriane is responsible for data management, analysis, and data sharing across the consortium.

[agronomy company logo]RovensaNext is a global leader in agricultural biosolutions, operating in more than 90 countries worldwide. The company conducts extensive biostimulant trials across diverse crops and environments. Bloomeo Biosolutions is used to centralize trial data, improve analysis, and support data-driven product development at scale.
